response.sql:
WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf
  FROM compliancecase
  GROUP BY brokrepstat
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS baseline_avg
  FROM status_averages
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT s.brokrepstat, s.avg_modelconf, b.baseline_avg
  FROM status_averages AS s
  CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
  WHERE s.avg_modelconf > b.baseline_avg
),
qualifying_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS qualifying_avg
  FROM qualifying
)
SELECT q.brokrepstat AS status,
       q.avg_modelconf AS average_model_confidence,
       q.avg_modelconf - q.baseline_avg AS average_minus_baseline,
       q.avg_modelconf / qm.qualifying_avg AS average_divided_by_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying AS q
CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean AS qm
WHERE q.baseline_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND qm.qualifying_avg IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: SQLite GROUP BY NULL treats cases with no broker reporting status as one distinct status group, and AVG ignores NULL confidence values as requested.
